feature: Manual entry of filament price and grams
notes: Reference calculates material cost proportionally; app must accept independent user values.

feature: Import local G-code from multiple slicers through parser adapters
notes: A streaming metadata parser prototype now targets Anycubic Kobra X / Anycubic Slicer Next 2.0.0.3; code has not been validated, and other slicers remain future adapters.

feature: Edit imported values manually
notes: Imported metadata must remain editable and its source/confidence should be visible.

feature: Print duration in hours and minutes
notes: Minutes are bounded from 0 to 59 in the reference.

feature: Average printer power in watts
notes: Reference offers indicative model shortcuts; users need manual entry.

feature: Electricity price per kWh with Brazilian state presets
notes: 27 UF values observed; source, methodology and freshness need verification.

feature: Electricity flag surcharge
notes: Green, yellow, red tier 1 and red tier 2 values are selectable additions.

feature: Printer depreciation by price and useful life
notes: Optional formula distributes machine price over service hours.

feature: Failure allowance
notes: Optional reserve formula uses filament, energy and depreciation subtotal.

feature: Labor and fixed per-piece costs
notes: Optional monetary additions to total cost.

feature: Packaging and shipping configuration
notes: Packaging joins cost; shipping can be passed through or included in cost.

feature: Profit as percentage or fixed currency amount
notes: The reference supports both modes.

feature: Sales fees and taxes
notes: Applied to final price by grossing up the cost-plus-profit amount.

feature: Cost breakdown and real margin result
notes: Show component totals, sale price, profit and margin.

feature: Generate editable quote as PDF
notes: Observed on the reference site but explicitly excluded from the initial calc3D app scope.

feature: Offline local calculation and file processing
notes: Do not upload G-code or quote data by default.

feature: Windows desktop distribution
notes: First target platform requested by owner.

feature: Keep path to future macOS support
notes: Second target platform requested by owner.

feature: Editable material and printer profiles
notes: Reusable local presets for prices, power, printer cost and useful life.

feature: Versioned electricity data with source and validity dates
notes: Prevent stale or unverifiable UF values from appearing authoritative.

feature: Local history and reusable calculations
notes: Save, duplicate and reopen calculations without cloud account.

feature: Accessible keyboard-first interface
notes: Support keyboard navigation, screen readers and explicit units.

feature: Publish contributor documentation and project license
notes: MIT selected; contributor guide drafted, but project workflow still needs a stack and CI.

feature: Additional manufacturing materials/processes
notes: Potential future expansion beyond filament-based FDM printing.

feature: Export calculation data to CSV or JSON
notes: Useful for bookkeeping and open workflows.

feature: Calculate costs for multiple materials in one print
notes: The local calculation core sums material cost by spool; not yet reviewed or validated.

feature: Calculate energy wear failures fees and sale price from explicit inputs
notes: A dependency-free local formula module exists; state tariff data and validation remain pending.
